title: Sync local devices to a remote API
hints: Index both lists into dicts keyed by the normalised serial (serial.strip().upper()); while indexing, raise ValueError on a blank serial or a key you have already seen. Do this before touching the client.
Set arithmetic gives the groups: local - remote to create, remote - local to delete, local & remote to compare. Sort each.
For a shared serial build changes = {f: mine.get(f) for f in fields if mine.get(f) != theirs.get(f)}; an empty dict means unchanged.
Separate planning from acting: compute the three lists, then loop over them calling the client unless dry_run; the summary is just the serial lists.
